origin_diagnosis: B02 shorts with at most 20 pips of side-aligned four-hour M15-open movement have negative baseline P/L in 2023 and both 2024 halves. Blocking them improves every period but leaves 2023 negative. The 20-to-40-pip band has no stable pre-entry discriminator, so Family I cannot be repaired.
causal_hypothesis: A downside B02 session breakout without an established four-hour downtrend is a false break. Executing an opposite long mean-reversion trade at the same entry time and fixed horizon should convert the recurring short-trade loss into positive expectancy rather than merely avoiding it.
target_action: replace the short with a long
prior_work_reviewed: R1 generic failed-excursion and trend candidate universe

novelty.not_family_I: Family I suppressed the B02 short; Family J opens an opposite long and asserts a positive mean-reversion payoff.
novelty.not_family_A: Family A tested F05 pre-entry candle-acceptance filters, not B02 direction reversal after a weak-trend session break.
novelty.not_generic_failed_excursion: The accepted B02 close outside its session range is retained as the event; reversal is conditioned on four-hour trend insufficiency and does not require an intrabar return inside the range before entry.
novelty.not_threshold_repair: The thresholds are the already frozen countertrend boundary 0 and recurring-loss boundary 20; the new information is the opposite action and its execution payoff.

finite_grid.reverse_if: strategy == B02 and original_side == -1 and side_aligned_open_move_4h_pips <= threshold_pips

execution_contract.entry_price: Ask at the accepted entry M15 bar-open
execution_contract.exit_time: same accepted B02 fixed 48-bar exit UTC
execution_contract.exit_price: Bid at the exit M15 bar-open
execution_contract.later_signals: unchanged because accepted B02/F05 signal definitions are market-data-only
execution_contract.portfolio_exposure: recompute candidate position direction for overlap and drawdown attribution

development_periods.2024_H2: development and cross-regime period under policy v4

required_metrics: candidate total, B02 and reversal-component net/PF by period
reversed positions and entry dates by month and quarter

gates.parameter_identifiability: collapse cells with identical reversed trade keys and identical candidate outcomes before ranking

ranking: minimum candidate total net across the three periods
falsification: no cell makes every development period profitable with PF at least 1
the reversal component loses in any development period
monthly breadth or concentration gates fail
market-price execution does not match the fixed-spread algebra
the selected threshold is not identifiable
prohibited: No reversal of B02 longs or F05 signals
No combination with closed F05 candidates
No 2025 outcome use before exact Research-to-MT4 parity and explicit registry authorization
